plan.objective: Squared per-player two-minute-bin occupancy error + v49 pair weight .25 times squared whole-game pair overlap error + existing minimumStint/600 per substitution + short-stint shortfall in minutes. All weights fixed before first simulation. Exact five per slot, rounded per-player slots sum480, official starters at first slot. Deterministic quota-preserving rectangle swaps; game RNG unchanged.
plan.scope: Known game minute reconstruction; source profiles exclude entire game fold. No target-game stint sequence, scoring outcome, or player-name overrides. Joint feasibility guarantees apply to the planned grid, not real dead-ball execution or foul-outs.
plan.replanning: Crop the source phase distribution to remaining clock, redistribute unreachable minute budgets over available players with per-player remaining-clock caps, enforce five per future grid slot, and optimize residual pair targets. Record repairs. No claim to recover minutes after an already completed disqualification.

selection: Same >1% objective, each-season regulation minute <=baseline+0.05 and short-share <=baseline+0.01 on three-seed means. No candidate re-selection or further tuning.
runtime: Execute the joint plan coherently: current-time cumulative deficit and source minimum-stint occupancy preference. Historical stint/rest are penalties in the joint planner rather than a second contradictory hard lock. Remove heuristic mandatory G/big coverage for this plan-based policy; the learned full five-player plan supplies composition. Preserve health/foul eligibility, minute exhaustion and protected shooter. This is a separate candidate, not an adopted change.
revision: Joint execution plus hard remaining-minute feasibility: every available player whose remaining budget reaches all remaining clock time must be on court when feasible with protected shooter; preserve valid players in slots when forcing urgent players. Report conflicts instead of claiming impossible budgets are achieved.
reason: A static full-game plan becomes infeasible after foul-outs and accumulated dead-ball delays. Replan at quarter openings and changes to available players from the actual credited minutes. Existing source profiles, pair totals and probability inputs retained. Original three-seed thresholds unchanged.
